notes.title: Introducing our new project: MATCHO
notes.content:
[b]Dear Endera agents,[/b]
It has been a while since we talked about new stuff in our development team. Since BLACKHOLE, we strive to create better games, trying to outdo ourselves. Therefore, we are proud to present our newest project to you: [url=https://playmatcho.com][b]MATCHO[/b][/url].

[b]Matcho is a unique action-adventure match-3 shooter that plays like no other FPS game you've ever experienced. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6826010/9cd794867db905a2bc7e112b25937c74bbf8612e.png[/img]

Start your new epic journey with Max and his friends as he tackles a mysterious alien invasion that could lead to curing his illness and saving the Earth.

Fight in action-packed arenas like never before and explore intricate areas –⁠ all that with breathtaking visuals and an insane arsenal of abilities, including the freedom of parkour movement.

[previewyoutube=PGL4q5VYnP8;full][/previewyoutube]
It's Match-3 FPS - a unique combination of genres that merges frenetic shooting with quick decision-making. Explore story-driven chapters as you choose destiny for Max, his friends, and the rest of the world.

Also, we hope that you will be surprised since MATCHO's story is happening in the shared universe with BLACKHOLE.

[list]
[*]Intense and clever tactical fighting built around the match-3 shooter concept.
[*]Dazzling visuals powered by Unreal Engine.
[*]A non-linear, humor-packed plot with multiple endings.
[*]An extensive, built-in parkour system lets you wall-run, double-jump, float, and dash in any direction.
[*]A modern take on clever puzzle design and the platforming experience.
[*]Spectacular combo chains to launch, execute, and enjoy.
[*]A cast of colorful characters with full English voiceovers.
[*]Accessibility settings for colorblindness and difficulty curve.
[/list]
The game is coming on Steam sometime around Q4 2022 / Q1 2023. So feel free to join the discussion on our new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/878210/MATCHO/]Steam page[/url] for the project.

Learn more at [url=https://playmatcho.com]https://playmatcho.com[/url]

We hope you will enjoy the news,
FiolaSoft Studio ːaurielː

notes.title: BLACKHOLE is coming to Xbox One and PS4 on Aug 8th, Last Mission is still in development
notes.content:

Yesterday we announced the console version of BLACKHOLE. We wanted to announce it so many months ago, but unfortunately, the process of publishing the console version is harder than we thought. Anyway, a lot of you are asking us how's the work on BLACKHOLE: Last Mission going.

Last Mission, of course, is still in our plan. Unfortunately, some complications occurred in the financing itself. Thank you for your patience. We're trying to do our best.

notes.title: BLACKHOLE 1.9 AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
[b]Dear Endera Agents,[/b]
The newest patch is now available for everyone using Windows, MacOS and Linux. This new update is focused on stability and performance issues instead of adding new features. We have revamped a lot of internal systems to create a smoother gameplay experience. It has been a really long and ongoing process over the last whole year (unbelievable).

Besides fixing the smaller bugs, we deactivated uploading your previous progress on Challenge Vault server. From now on you can't upload your older times and you have to achieve them again in order to get them uploaded. The previous solution had been fair until the newcomers started to be affected by ghost-players, who weren't playing BLACKHOLE but just started the game recently. The times for LEVEL 10 and SOE LEVEL 1 are purged for every player as the replays and times unfortunately got corrupted by this update.

We tried to avoid this purge as much as we could, but unfortunately the changes made in our game recently unabled us to solve this in another way.

We hope you all will enjoy our improvements. You can find the changelog below.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/4b2463e89a894bda94c17fd8ff10bd57a50d8a8a.png[/img]

[h1]1.9 CHANGE LOG[/h1]
[b]MAIN ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed more than 300 small bugs
    [*]2015 profile upload to Challenge Vault server deactivated
    [*]Fixed the blocker when skipping the main menu during the start of the game
    [*]New function in leaderboards - skip on top / bottom
    [*]New "Director's Cut" dialogue lines
    [*]Fixed spacing in subtitles for all languages
    [*]Fixed minor mistakes in all languages
    [*]We removed all "inappropriate language" from the dialogues in respect of rating
    [*]Fixed Challenge Vault functionality for Vanilla Levels
    [*]Xinput & Direct Input Controllers are now supported on MacOS
    [*]Added Direct Input Controllers functionality for DualShock 4 Controller to options menu
 [/list]
[b]RESOLVED ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*](FIX) Fixed names of achievements
    [*](FIX) New asynchronous save system
    [*](FIX) New asynchronous loading system
    [*](FIX) Fixed players' names in leaderboards
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug causing that controller's vibration function continues indefinitely
    [*](FIX) Fixed achievement for "Spilled coffee" which was granted everytime even if the player didn't spill the coffee
    [*](NEW) Added the information to the profile about the game completion in percantage (%)
    [*](NEW) Added functionality which will copy your original profile when entering into Easy Mode - that way, you can switch back later without losing your progress
    [*](NEW) Now instead of text representation, you will see actual icons on selected controller in options menu
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
We are working hard to fix these reported issues as soon as possible:
[list]
    [*]There aren't any issues right now. If you know about some bug which affected your gameplay, please tell us here:  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We finished the console version of BLACKHOLE last week. And since we are waiting for its release, we can finally move to our planned spin-off. We announced BLACKHOLE: Last Mission in the Czech Republic, but very soon we will have more information in English, too. Stay tuned! You can check [url=https://blackhole-game.com/lastmission]the website of the game[/url] for more information.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/a7bb70e2279ca68524799fe358f6b154f2c2cc7e.png[/img]

We want to thank you for all of your reviews and all the reported bugs. We are fully focused on making the game even more enjoyable and looking forward to hearing how you'll like the update on our Steam [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]!

Also, we have released a troubleshoot article to help you solve various problems with the game. Feel free to check it out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]here[/url]! :)

Enjoy the game,
FiolaSoft Studio :auriel:

notes.title: Tips you may have missed
notes.content:
We have prepared a special list of a few interesting features and options that BLACKHOLE offers and you may have not known about them before. 

[list]
    [*][b]Collector’s Edition - extra content[/b]
    [*][b]DLCs and bonus levels[/b]
    [*][b]Leaderboards and replay system[/b]
    [*][b]In-game tools and statistics[/b]
    [*][b]Increasing FPS for better performance[/b]
    [*][b]Using controllers[/b]
    [*][b]You don’t have to collect all selfburns[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]Collector’s Edition - Extra Bonus Content[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/614319bd367c5503cc1904fc65c12346986d8158.png[/img]

In case you have bought BLACKHOLE: Collector’s Edition, you can check out some of the extras that come with the game. The bonus content includes things such as the digital artbook, soundtrack in MP3 and FLAC, wallpapers and the original prototype of the game!

You can find these files in the folder with game content (install folder of the game). It is probably something like: [code]steamapps\common\BLACKHOLE\COLLECTORS CONTENT[/code] folder, and the soundtrack is located in [code]steamapps\common\BLACKHOLE\OST[/code] folder.

Together with extra content you also have access to all the DLCs and bonus levels!

[h1][b]DLCs and bonus levels[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/5215f5de83726cc649e2912599ea81e17a940d2e.png[/img]

There are several DLCs available in the Collector’s Edition of BLACKHOLE - [b]Testing Laboratory[/b], [b]Challenge Vault[/b], [b]Secret of the Entity[/b] and [b]Director’s Cut[/b]. You can access all of them right away, but it is highly recommended to complete the main gameplay and story sequence first!

[b]Testing Laboratory[/b] contains 10 new tests as well as some back story on the Endera mission (and what happened before the events of the main story).

[b]Director’s Cut[/b] contains 10 difficult levels, which are meant to challenge even the best BLACKHOLE players. Most of these levels were too hard for the main game, so they were replaced by their easier counterparts. But in case you want to really test your skills, try to complete all of them (preferably after you beat the main game)!

[b]Challenge Vault[/b] is probably the most unique out of these three DLCs - it consists of 15 levels, but each of them can be played only for one week. Your time gets uploaded to in-game leaderboards, where you can compete with all the other players. At the end of the 15th week, the winner gets announced and they become the [i]King of the Vault[/i] for that season! Next season of Challenge Vault is going to start very soon, so [b]be sure to participate[/b]!

[b]Secret of the Entity[/b] will unlock once you finish the main story line. This DLC adds more "end game" content and additional story events. The twelve levels of this DLC are very challenging!

[h1][b]Leaderboards and replay system[/b][/h1]

Leaderboards are not just for Challenge Vault, they are also available in the original game levels! After completing each level (and collecting all selfburns), your time gets uploaded to the global leaderboards.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/217e6c3d538612dbd8d594daf5867a27581f7bf0.png[/img]

[i]NOTE: If you complete the level under a certain time, you will get a "Coffee Time" award (as shown in the picture).[/i]

To access the leaderboards, enter the game, pause it and use the in-game menu select [i]“Leaderboards”[/i]. The compact version of leaderboards is also shown after you complete a level. Another option is to pause the game while being in a specific level - that way you can quickly open the leaderboards of the current level. You can view your position as well as time of other players.

You can also share the replay of your level, if you would like to show others how you have managed to complete it. Use [i]“Share Replay”[/i] to do so. You can also view the replays of other players - in case they shared it. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/33e16f608d1b0b362b1dbb76e28a0e970d335187.png[/img]

Also, here is a really cool tip for you: There is an option to turn on the specator mode, so you can move around the level while the replay is playing back! You can use this to directly compete with someone else, or to check out some move by repeating it after the replay ghost!


[h1][b]In-game tools and statistics[/b][/h1]

While you are exploring the overworld, you can display a 3D visualisation of The Entity. You can activate it by pressing the “N” key, “Tab” key or the left shoulder button on your Xbox controller. This is a great tool to check out the secrets scattered around the environment.

While you are in a level, you can also explore it by moving the camera around. Simply hold down [b]“Q”[/b] key, [b]“M”[/b] key or [b]left trigger[/b] on your Xbox controller, then use arrows or joystick to move your view around. You may notice arrows pointing in various directions - these are meant to guide you to a collectible or a task nearby. This can come in handy when you get lost.

When you pause the game while being in the overworld, you can view your statistics on the right side of the in-game menu. It displays stats like the amount of opened levels, total of collected Selfburns or how far you ran in total. You can also view the total number of your deaths!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/0af1daebd3351f07119fee0bf2cffdcbe5abfcca.png[/img]

One of the useful features found in the in-game menu is the [i]“Teleport”[/i] option. With this, you can quickly teleport to levels you have been in before. This can save you a lot of time you would spend by returning back through the Entity. On the other hand, you may find some hidden collectibles if you choose to explore the overworld. Another menu option is to view found blackboxes and dog tags. You can access them by choosing [i]“Collectibles”[/i] from the in-game menu.

And finally, [b]the ultimate lifehack[/b] - if you hold down the restart button while being in the overworld, you can quickly teleport to the spaceship!

[h1][b]Increasing FPS for better performance[/b][/h1]

In the newest version of BLACKHOLE ([b]1.7[/b]), we did a lot of optimization work. We improved and revamped a lot of game systems such as light engine, shadows and asynchronous saving. If you are still experiencing problems with low FPS or stuttering, please consider following steps:

[list]
[*]Set [i]"Shadows"[/i] to [i]"Disabled"[/i]
[*]Change [i]"Background Quality"[/i] to [i]"Low"[/i]
[*]Set [i]"Parallax"[/i] to [i]"Disabled"[/i]
[*]Set [i]"Particle Quality"[/i] to [i]"Low"[/i]
[*]Set [i]"Extra Effects"[/i] to [i]"Low"[/i]
[*]Set [i]"Shaders"[/i] to [i]"Disabled"[/i]
[/list]

You don’t have to change all of these options, feel free to combine them in different ways. However, turning most of them off should rapidly increase your frame rate - but the game will use lower quality textures and effects, so it won't look as good.

Please, be aware that our game is [b]not meant to be played on Intel HD Graphics (integrated graphics cards)[/b], but the game [b]may be functional[/b] on them.

Also make sure you are using the newest hardware drivers and the most recent version of your operating system. And if you are experiencing any trouble, [url=https://blackhole-game.com/en/contact]let us know immediately[/url].	

[h1][b]Using controllers[/b][/h1]

We [b]recommend to use the Xbox 360 Controller or Xbox One Controller[/b] for BLACKHOLE. However, all Xinput controllers may be functional, but we did not test them. Feel free to experiment in this area, but please make sure that you are going to follow the right button layout - the one from Xbox 360 Controller.

If you decide to use PS4 controller, rebind your controls to be same as Xbox 360 Controller, then in the game switch the icons for buttons in options menu / controller scheme.

If you have a keyboard or Xbox 360 Controller, you are ready for an adventure out of the box - no matter what platform you use. If you would like to know how to install drivers for controllers on Linux and Mac, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]follow our guide[/url].

[h1][b]You don’t have to collect all selfburns[/b][/h1]

A crucial moment of BLACKHOLE is also the time when you have to decide to let go of trying to collect all the selfburns in a level and continue in the story instead of repeating same level again and again. [b]You need just one selfburn to unlock the next level[/b], so sometimes it is better to move onto a different level. Of course there are times, when you will need to go back to earlier levels. notes.title: Tips you may have missed
notes.content:
We have prepared a special list of a few interesting features and options that BLACKHOLE offers and you may have not known about them before. 

[list]
    [*][b]Collector’s Edition - extra content[/b]
    [*][b]DLCs and bonus levels[/b]
    [*][b]Leaderboards and replay system[/b]
    [*][b]In-game tools and statistics[/b]
    [*][b]Increasing FPS for better performance[/b]
    [*][b]Using controllers[/b]
    [*][b]You don’t have to collect all selfburns[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]Collector’s Edition - Extra Bonus Content[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/614319bd367c5503cc1904fc65c12346986d8158.png[/img]

In case you have bought BLACKHOLE: Collector’s Edition, you can check out some of the extras that come with the game. The bonus content includes things such as the digital artbook, soundtrack in MP3 and FLAC, wallpapers and the original prototype of the game!

You can find these files in the folder with game content (install folder of the game). It is probably something like: [code]steamapps\common\BLACKHOLE\COLLECTORS CONTENT[/code] folder, and the soundtrack is located in [code]steamapps\common\BLACKHOLE\OST[/code] folder.

Together with extra content you also have access to all the DLCs and bonus levels!

[h1][b]DLCs and bonus levels[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/5215f5de83726cc649e2912599ea81e17a940d2e.png[/img]

There are several DLCs available in the Collector’s Edition of BLACKHOLE - [b]Testing Laboratory[/b], [b]Challenge Vault[/b], [b]Secret of the Entity[/b] and [b]Director’s Cut[/b]. You can access all of them right away, but it is highly recommended to complete the main gameplay and story sequence first!

[b]Testing Laboratory[/b] contains 10 new tests as well as some back story on the Endera mission (and what happened before the events of the main story).

[b]Director’s Cut[/b] contains 10 difficult levels, which are meant to challenge even the best BLACKHOLE players. Most of these levels were too hard for the main game, so they were replaced by their easier counterparts. But in case you want to really test your skills, try to complete all of them (preferably after you beat the main game)!

[b]Challenge Vault[/b] is probably the most unique out of these three DLCs - it consists of 15 levels, but each of them can be played only for one week. Your time gets uploaded to in-game leaderboards, where you can compete with all the other players. At the end of the 15th week, the winner gets announced and they become the [i]King of the Vault[/i] for that season! Next season of Challenge Vault is going to start very soon, so [b]be sure to participate[/b]!

[b]Secret of the Entity[/b] will unlock once you finish the main story line. This DLC adds more "end game" content and additional story events. The twelve levels of this DLC are very challenging!

[h1][b]Leaderboards and replay system[/b][/h1]

Leaderboards are not just for Challenge Vault, they are also available in the original game levels! After completing each level (and collecting all selfburns), your time gets uploaded to the global leaderboards.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/217e6c3d538612dbd8d594daf5867a27581f7bf0.png[/img]

[i]NOTE: If you complete the level under a certain time, you will get a "Coffee Time" award (as shown in the picture).[/i]

To access the leaderboards, enter the game, pause it and use the in-game menu select [i]“Leaderboards”[/i]. The compact version of leaderboards is also shown after you complete a level. Another option is to pause the game while being in a specific level - that way you can quickly open the leaderboards of the current level. You can view your position as well as time of other players.

You can also share the replay of your level, if you would like to show others how you have managed to complete it. Use [i]“Share Replay”[/i] to do so. You can also view the replays of other players - in case they shared it. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/33e16f608d1b0b362b1dbb76e28a0e970d335187.png[/img]

Also, here is a really cool tip for you: There is an option to turn on the specator mode, so you can move around the level while the replay is playing back! You can use this to directly compete with someone else, or to check out some move by repeating it after the replay ghost!


[h1][b]In-game tools and statistics[/b][/h1]

While you are exploring the overworld, you can display a 3D visualisation of The Entity. You can activate it by pressing the “N” key, “Tab” key or the left shoulder button on your Xbox controller. This is a great tool to check out the secrets scattered around the environment.

While you are in a level, you can also explore it by moving the camera around. Simply hold down [b]“Q”[/b] key, [b]“M”[/b] key or [b]left trigger[/b] on your Xbox controller, then use arrows or joystick to move your view around. You may notice arrows pointing in various directions - these are meant to guide you to a collectible or a task nearby. This can come in handy when you get lost.

When you pause the game while being in the overworld, you can view your statistics on the right side of the in-game menu. It displays stats like the amount of opened levels, total of collected Selfburns or how far you ran in total. You can also view the total number of your deaths!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6826010/0af1daebd3351f07119fee0bf2cffdcbe5abfcca.png[/img]

One of the useful features found in the in-game menu is the [i]“Teleport”[/i] option. With this, you can quickly teleport to levels you have been in before. This can save you a lot of time you would spend by returning back through the Entity. On the other hand, you may find some hidden collectibles if you choose to explore the overworld. Another menu option is to view found blackboxes and dog tags. You can access them by choosing [i]“Collectibles”[/i] from the in-game menu.

And finally, [b]the ultimate lifehack[/b] - if you hold down the restart button while being in the overworld, you can quickly teleport to the spaceship!

[h1][b]Increasing FPS for better performance[/b][/h1]

In the newest version of BLACKHOLE ([b]1.7[/b]), we did a lot of optimization work. We improved and revamped a lot of game systems such as light engine, shadows and asynchronous saving. If you are still experiencing problems with low FPS or stuttering, please consider following steps:

[list]
[*]Set [i]"Shadows"[/i] to [i]"Disabled"[/i]
[*]Change [i]"Background Quality"[/i] to [i]"Low"[/i]
[*]Set [i]"Parallax"[/i] to [i]"Disabled"[/i]
[*]Set [i]"Particle Quality"[/i] to [i]"Low"[/i]
[*]Set [i]"Extra Effects"[/i] to [i]"Low"[/i]
[*]Set [i]"Shaders"[/i] to [i]"Disabled"[/i]
[/list]

You don’t have to change all of these options, feel free to combine them in different ways. However, turning most of them off should rapidly increase your frame rate - but the game will use lower quality textures and effects, so it won't look as good.

Please, be aware that our game is [b]not meant to be played on Intel HD Graphics (integrated graphics cards)[/b], but the game [b]may be functional[/b] on them.

Also make sure you are using the newest hardware drivers and the most recent version of your operating system. And if you are experiencing any trouble, [url=https://blackhole-game.com/en/contact]let us know immediately[/url].

We [b]recommend to use the Xbox 360 Controller or Xbox One Controller[/b] for BLACKHOLE. However, all Xinput controllers may be functional, but we did not test them. Feel free to experiment in this area, but please make sure that you are going to follow the right button layout - the one from Xbox 360 Controller.

If you decide to use PS4 controller, rebind your controls to be same as Xbox 360 Controller, then in the game switch the icons for buttons in options menu / controller scheme.

If you have a keyboard or Xbox 360 Controller, you are ready for an adventure out of the box - no matter what platform you use. If you would like to know how to install drivers for controllers on Linux and Mac, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]follow our guide[/url].

notes.title: Windows 10 + HD Graphics problems and refunds
notes.content:
Dear players,
 for several weeks We were trying to recover and run update for better Intel HD Graphics experience. The game is crashing, especially on Windows 10 because of changes made by Intel in drivers. To better understand our struggle, it's like driving a car on the highway, but with constantly changing the surface of the road. We are aware of that, but can't do pretty much anything about it right away. We have to learn and adapt our export to that. And that's not instant.

Our Blackhole is now at stage where we want to activate online mode. We are working on this for very long time. This is causing some trouble to quickly adapt & respond to each problem you have. But we are still trying to solve all problems you experienced. Even on Laptops systems which are not supported natively because all of this.

We are really sorry to see many of you going to refund just because the crash on the intro without contacting our support or writing into our phorums, but this is something what we have to accept as it is. We will of course try to do better in the future, but you should know that we really care about our players - about you. 

Thank you for your patience and to give it a try at first.

If you are not able to play our game - if it is crashing on your system or you have any other problems, you should maybe try to change game into Beta Version, where we are testing newest builds and trying to catch every problem before we release such update world-wide.

[list]
    [*]Go into your Library in Steam
    [*]Find Blackhole
    [*]Open Blackhole Properties
    [*]There is section "Betas"

    [*]No need enter password

notes.title: The biggest update is here – 1.0.5C OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Several months past after we have made the biggest preparations for console launch of the game. And since it’s coming for Xbox One and PlayStation 4 some additional features, we implemented the same features into our Windows and Linux version as well.

[i][b]We want to apologize to all Mac version players. This following update is not compatible with Mac OS X yet. But we are working hard to finish update also for OS X version as soon as possible. Thank you for understanding.[/b][/i]

[img]http://www.blackhole-game.com/uploads/bh_language_update.png[/img]

We have hopefully resolved the biggest issues with controllers, several layout issues in GUI, we updated our FONT to newest version which currently supports also Cyrillic charset – making the game available also in all-native Russian language!

On top of that, we have fixed more than 300 bugs/glitches, made big optimization of both: the code and the engine. This update signed under 1.0.5C is also nicknamed as CONSOLE READY. And we are proud to announce the game is coming to Xbox One and PlayStation 4 really soon this year! :)

Right now, we have last big step ahead in our Blackhole journey. Release of completely new FREE DLC called “Challenge Vault”. Challenge Vault will uncover each week for several times new levels – each week you can run through the level and be the BEST from the best and stand on the top.

Challenge Vault is feature available only for STEAM version of the game, and it will be great thing for everyone seeking the "multiplayer" element in our game. :)

[b]MAIN ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed more than 300+ bugs across the game
    [*]Added new language: Russian
    [*]Revamped Endera graphics
    [*]Newly scripted intro section
    [*]Steam Controller Support
    [*]New loading system (slower, but efficient for laptop users)
    [*]New controllers finder procedure
    [*]Brand new locations in the game to explore (2 for each entity!)
    [*]Improved overall FPS rate in the Sacred Library
    [*]Replaced some sounds to higher quality ones
    [*]Fixed graphical issues for most of the integrated graphics cards
    [*]Fixed textures fallout on Intel HD Graphics
    [*]New texture streaming causing overall less RAM usage
    [*]Improvement movement for the character
    [*]Added Rage Quit Shortcut [ALT+F4]
    [*]Fixed problem with newest DirectX library causing Blackhole won't start
 [/list]
[b]RESOLVED ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*](NEW) Added MASTER VOLUME option 
    [*](FIX) Fixed several camera issues during cutscenes
    [*](FIX) Fixed glitched map on Linux
    [*](FIX) Sacred Library – Elevator – jump through walls
    [*](FIX) Starting spectator mode hides the result screen
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue when Ati leaving Sacred Library, he got stuck into doors – jumping
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue when Selassie is trying to run to you – glitches
    [*](FIX) Fixed both endings – bad language file in English mode
    [*](FIX) Fixed graphics glitches causing lines around object on smaller resolutions of the game
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue, when WIND were disabling some sounds unintentionally
    [*](FIX) Fixed issue with neverending Quest from Selassie after finishing the game
    [*](FIX) Fixed several dialogues errors (dialogues which had never chance to play)
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Crazy avalanche run is 3x slower
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Lava run is 3x slower 
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Blocks in desert entity are disintegrate 3x more slowly 
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Rescuing the crew members are easier than in original mode
    [*](TWEAK) Easy mode: Finding all missing parts are easier than ever 
[/list]

[list]
    [*]Issue causing letterbox when is the screenshot saved under smaller resolutions than 1920x1080.

    [*](Mac OS X Only) Missing Steam Overlay

[h1]What next?[/h1]
We are now working on Challenge Vault DLC. In the meantime, don't miss the opportunity to get some additional content for the game:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/322700
http://store.steampowered.com/app/323650

We want to thank you for all of your positive reviews and all the reported bugs. We are fully focused on making the game even more enjoyable and looking forward to hear how you like the update on our Steam [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]!

Also, we have released troubleshoot article to solve many problems with the game. Feel free to check it out on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]this link[/url]! :)

Enjoy the game,

notes.title: Problem with starting Blackhole? Here's solution!
notes.content:
[b]UPDATED ON 2/9/2016 - This problem should be resolved now. You don't have to go into beta channel anymore. Game should start well as usual.[/b]

[b]Dear players,[/b]
 we have new reported problem with BLACKHOLE and Intel HD Graphics / AMD chipsets. The newest Intel drivers unfortunately causing the problem with DirectX 9.0C and BLACKHOLE stop responding or doesn't working correctly.

The same problem also often triggers the message that the DRIVER has crashed and was restored.

Please, let me really apologize for this trouble. But on the other hand it's nothing we could prevent from. We have to update our code, and bring support for more laptop players. That said, we are working really hard for 2 months now to release brand new version of BLACKHOLE, which will solve like almost 300 bugs and adds new locations & puzzles for free.

But, here comes the sad part: we are not still ready to release stable version yet. For that reason, we created [b]public beta branch[/b] for those, whose experiencing problems with starting the game. This public beta contains everything what we'd planned to release next week.

[h1]How to activate Public Beta of Blackhole:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Go into your Library in Steam
    [*]Find Blackhole
    [*]Open Blackhole Properties
    [*]There is section "Betas"
    [*]Select "beta - Public Beta Branch"
    [*]No need enter password
    [*]Download the update
    [*]Try to play game now! :)
[/list]

Don't worry about your save-files or collector's content. Nothing in local data will be changed using this beta branch. Only "early access" game content will be updated.

We really hope this beta version will help those, who experiecing difficulties with running the game. When the final version of the update will be ready - we move version into the stable (default) channel. You can change from beta branch to default at any time - [b]save files are backward compatible[/b].

Thank you very much for your patience and support. If you need any special support, don't worry to contact us directly using kontakt@fiolasoft.cz - thank you!

PS: If you have problem with running the game, would you mind to tell us your CPU, GPU and OS? If you want to help us, leave them into comments below. It will give us the perspective, how large this problem is.

Have a great day,
[b]Fiola[/b]

notes.title: Easy & Less Dialogue Mode + FREE DEMO available now!
notes.content:
Good news for all 2D platformers’ fans out there who, until now, thought that Blackhole might turn out to be too hardcore for them. Not only Easy Mode was just added to the game, but the free demo is also now available. And if the amount of dialogues bugged you too, consider it solved as well.

[img]http://www.blackhole-game.com/uploads/bh_language_update.png[/img]

[h1]FREE DEMO[/h1]

Consisting of 5 diverse levels, the demo will allow gamers to get a glimpse of what’s best in Blackhole. Playing with gravity, solving puzzles and learning how to wall-jump should be enough to convince all not convinced yet, that it’s worth to join Endera crew and learn their story.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/395510
[h1]ADJUSTING THE AMOUNT OF DIALOGUE LINES[/h1]

Not a big fan of long chats between NPCs, that interrupt your platforming experience? No problem as from now on you’ll be able to choose ‘Less dialogues’ option and turn it on or off freely throughout your whole play through. This option doesn’t switch the story off completely. It only disables some side dialogue lines that are not core for the plot. And leaves you with pure, dynamic, platforming joy.

[h1]EASY MODE[/h1]

Unlike ‘Less dialogues’ this option can be chosen only once as it changes the gameplay massively. Also it disables most achievements based on hardcore playthrough and timing. And it won’t allow you to send time record or coffee-time for levels to online leaderboards. So be careful and think twice before enabling it! In the same time this may be a great solution for gamers who seemed to have problems with finishing the game but yet were keen on learning the whole story. 

Mostly because with Easy Mode on, you will be able to keep your collected selfburn if you die. And if you run over the start portal, your progress will be saved. Those, who already had a chance to try out the game know, that this will make beating the levels and solving puzzles significantly easier. And in result the game should be more accessible for casual gamers.

[h1]1.0.5B CHANGE LOG[/h1]
[b]MAIN ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed 120+ bugs across the game
    [*]Fixed some level solutions
    [*]New less dialogues mode
    [*]New easy mode
    [*]New options in the menu
    [*]New asynchronous save system
[/list]
[b]RESOLVED ISSUES[/b] 
[list]
    [*](FIX) Testing laboratory DLC loading fixed
    [*](FIX) New volume for some music files
    [*](FIX) Buttons are now more responsive
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug causing hack in Videogameception level
    [*](FIX) PS4 controller images fixed
    [*](FIX) New save system has now backup function
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug causing death for character close by you
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug with loading external resources
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug in datapads at Sacred Library location
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug causing hidden Ati's auto-batery
    [*](FIX) Fixed typos in english language file
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug causing sound loop and game crash in Sacred Library
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug causing that logo of the game is missing
    [*](FIX) Fixed bug when you're getting more than one quest at time
    [*](FIX) Fixed graphics glitches
    [*](FIX) Fixed some achievements
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
We are working hard to fix these reported issues as soon as possible:
[list]
    [*]We need to translate new lines for Secret of the Entity into all languages (missing lines are temporarily replaced by english)
    [*]Missing Steam Overlay in Mac OS X version (still under review)
[/list]

[h1]What next?[/h1]
We also want to inform all players that we are currently working on another big update for the game. Challenge Vault in version 1.0.6 will bring a new set of levels for free every week, also we will introduce the "online mode" for the game! Thank you for your patience and support!

In the meantime, don't miss the opportunity to get some additional content for the game:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/322700
http://store.steampowered.com/app/323650

We want to thank you for all of your positive reviews and all the reported bugs. We are fully focused on making the game even more enjoyable and looking forward to hear how you like the update on our Steam [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/322680/discussions/]Discussion forum[/url]!

Also, we have released troubleshoot article to solve many problems with the game. Feel free to check it out on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=504568920]this link[/url]! :)

Enjoy the game,
FiolaSoft Studio ːaurielː

notes.title: We hit the GAMESCOM 2015 and it was AWESOME
notes.content:
Blackhole hands on demo was available at Indie Arena Booth at GAMESCOM 2015. With several developers and computers on site it was possible to swing by any time and even without an appointment spent a couple of relaxing minutes trying out the game and chatting with developers about upcoming updates.

[img]https://scontent-fra3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xfp1/v/t1.0-9/11822808_751522758327357_6219720268710317818_n.jpg?oh=e7e230b5d3beb643f745a35eaa8feddc&oe=567A2533[/img]

[h1]EASY MODE INCOMING[/h1]
Based on community feedback & because we want to our game adjust also for casual or „mainstream“ players: the easy-mode is coming. If you experience the problem with finishing the game and you want to complete the story & enjoy the levels in "easier" way. The easy mode enabled could help you do that. 

In easy mode, when you collect selfburn and run over start portal - your progress is saved. If you die, you will respawn with already collected selfburn. This is so easier way how to solve many puzzles - so please, remember and think twice if you set your profile to easy mode - because there is no way how to set the easy mode off on that profile again.

[b][i]Be aware that enabling easy mode you will turn-off most of the achievements based on „hardcore“ gameplay and timing. Once you set easy mode on, it can’t be turned off on that game profile. Also with easy mode enabled you can't send time record or coffee-time for the levels to online leaderboards.[/i][/b]

[h1]LESS DIALOGUES MODE[/h1]

This mode (unlike the Easy mode) could be turned on and off anywhere & anytime in whole game. When you set the game into "less dialogues" mode; we will cut-off most unnecessary dialogues, so you will experience less story events (like by 60% less). This option is here for all who wants play only & mainly platform experience and story is for them some side-related thing.

We are not removing all the story! Story is still presented. We will just cut-off the lines that „extends the basic storyline“. So even with Less Dialogues on, you will have to repair the ship, hear all blackboxes & save everyone from the crew.

[img]https://scontent-fra3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xta1/v/t1.0-9/11813278_751522781660688_1262878546947355974_n.jpg?oh=7f0c9331bb4901f508fdf1d5c9dccc52&oe=564D2A5B[/img]

[h1]FREE DEMO WILL BE AVAILABLE[/h1]

We will also release the DEMO of the game in a few days for free on STEAM, to give a taste to everyone who wants the game just try & maybe we will convince some new players to join our Endera crew! :)

Our DEMO contains 5 levels, player will learn how gravity platforms works, then go to the jungle, experience puzzle in sacred library (city & emp glove), learn how to wall-jump and try to solve little puzzle in desert at one from „Eternal Thirst“ levels.

[h1]THIS BIG GAME UPDATE COMING IN A FEW DAYS![/h1]

Hope you will like how we expanding the game in order to get it more attractive for other players than just hardcore base.

Thank you! ♥
- Devs from FiolaSoft Studio

PS: Keep calm and make Cpt. Jetsen coffee! ːenderacoffeeː

notes.title: Secret of the Entity Free Expansion Available Now!
notes.content:
Who said 13th is a bad day of the month and in general brings bad luck? Well whoever it was apparently was completely wrong. I mean it can’t be such a bad day when today gamers all over the world, who already purchased the hardcore Blackhole platformer, get a massive add on to their space adventure. 5 hours of gameplay, even more challenging puzzles, new story and bursting with humor dialogues and all that for as little as... ZERO, NADA, NOTHING, NULL, with other words completely for FREE! How cool is that?!

[img]http://www.blackhole-game.com/uploads/bh_soe_update.png[/img]

[b]Now assuming that you have successfully rescued all crew members and repaired the ship you’re probably now ready to get back home.[/b] Right?

Not so fast soldier. How do you want to go back when The Endera spaceship tank is empty? You’ll need to refill it with gas. To do so follow Jetsen’s guidance in order to collect special black ‘selfburns’ and use them as Endera’s fuel. This should be easy right? In the end you already know the universe, are a master of turning levels upside down and nothing can surprise you. Or does it?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BLkol94fckw

[list]
    [*]Fixed 160+ major bugs in the whole game

    [*]Fixed major problems with controllers & key bindings
    [*]New story dialogues & missions
    [*]12 brand new hardcore levels
    [*]New exploration puzzles
    [*]New overworld map!
    [*]You can now mute characters by your selection
    [*]New stories in the Sacred Library! Search the datapads!
[/list]

[list]
    [*](NEW) New particles & effects on Endera
    [*](FIX) Fixed XBOX Controller detection on Windows, Linux & Mac OS X

notes.title: The completed version of Blackhole comes out on 27th February
notes.content:
We hereby announce that the official date of the Blackhole game release is the [b]27th of February[/b].

So what can you look forward to after the activation of the game? We have prepared strong road map for bringing even more game content after the launch! These things will come in the following weeks, so, how’s it gonna be?

[b]Briefly after the game is released, certain things will be unlocked during the March:[/b]
[list]	[*]The Mac version 1.0, complete Blackhole story[/*]	[*]The Linux version 1.0, complete Blackhole story[/*][*]Correction of any possible errors[/*]	[*]Improved graphics wherever needed (if anywhere at all)[/*][/list]
[b]During the April 2015:[/b]
[list]	[*]Online mode, rankings, the opportunity to share your time from levels with the world[/*]	[*]Challenge Vault ([b]a new level every week![/b])[/*]	[*]A big free update: „Secret Of The Entity“, which adds the story after you finish the game (yep, there’s more!)[/*][/list]
[b]Things to finally come in May 2015:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]DLC: Testing Laboratory – [/b]only those who own the Collector’s Edition will get the DLC. [b]You can’t buy it separately.[/b][/*][/list]

It’s been almost one year since we’d announced that we’re working on Blackhole, and it’s been a crazy year. So many events, so much work, and everything leads to one specific day: either everything’s going to work out, or it all ends up ruined.

We hope you get the best possible experience in our universe. We can't wait to see your feedback :). See you on 27th...
